input.question: How long can a single thread of spider silk get before it breaks under it's own weight?
input.ground_truth: Wikipedia says the breaking length of spider silk is 109km (_URL_0_). The breaking length is the length of a uniform wire (thread) of a given material which breaks under its own weight. By tapering the thread (thicker higher up and thinner further down) you could of course get a longer thread.
